title: 2026 Point72 Academy National Case Competition - US
description: 2026 Point72 Academy Case Competition—New York City The Point72 Academy Case Competition is your chance to showcase your investing skills by presenting a stock pitch to Point72 with a team from your university. You and one to three teammates will analyze a company, develop an investment thesis using publicly available sources only, and submit your pitch. Finalists will be paired with a Point72 mentor and given the opportunity to present their pitch to Point72 investment professionals in our New York City office. Prizes include scholarships and an accelerated interview process for future opportunities. Prep your pitch: Research a company selected by Point72, develop your investment thesis using publicly available sources only, and bring your analysis to life in a presentation. You’re encouraged to use AI thoughtfully to support your research and analysis. Refine with a Mentor: If your team is selected as a finalist, you’ll be paired with a Point72 mentor who will provide feedback as you prepare for the final round. Present your case: Finalist teams will travel to New York City to present their investment pitch to Point72 investors. You’ll also network with your peers and representatives from our recruiting, Academy, and investing teams.   How to Participate in the Point72 Academy Case Competition—New York City   1. Register   Form a team of two to four students from the same U.S. university. All team members must be in their first or second year of university (no third-year or higher students are eligible).   Choose a team captain and a team name.   The team captain will be responsible for submitting one application on behalf of the team and upload a resume for each member.   The deadline for registration is October 1, 2026.   2. Submit    On October 2, 2026 , team captains will receive the case assignment and submission instructions.   Teams must submit their presentation by October 12, 2026 .   3. Finalist Competition   Finalists will be notified by October 26, 2026.   Each finalist team will be paired with a Point72 mentor for a 60-minute feedback session.   Final presentations must be submitted by November 9, 2026.   The Finalist Competition will take place in New York City on November 12–13.     Case Competition Timeline October 1, 2026   Registration closes October 2, 2026   Case assignment sent via email to team captains October 12, 2026   Deadline to submit presentation October 26, 2026   Finalists announced & Point72 mentors assigned November 9, 2026   Deadline to submit final presentation November 12 – 13, 2026   Finalist Case Competition in New York     Competition Rules and Important Considerations for Applicants Eligibility and Registration : All team members must attend the same accredited U.S. undergraduate institution and remain enrolled there throughout the competition. Students graduating outside the December 2028–July 2030 eligibility window are not eligible. Teams that do not follow the registration requirements may be disqualified. Final Round Requirements : All team members must be available to attend the final round in New York City on November 12–13. Each team member must have a speaking role in the final presentation. Teams with absent members may be disqualified. Travel and Accommodations: Point72 will cover travel and accommodation expenses within reason. Contact Information : If you have further questions, please contact us at AcademyRecruiting@point72.com .
